_doc: Items. 'effects' use the shared effect keys handled by src/core/systems/effects.gd (qi, alignment, items, breakthrough_bonus (with optional breakthrough_realm: realm id; the item only works while the next realm you would break into is that one, and only while no other breakthrough_realm boost is waiting: one pill per attempt), set_flag, learn_technique, heal_injury, learn_recipe, burn_lifespan, extend_lifespan, buff, bloodline). price is in spirit stones; 0 = not sold. tags (optional) group items: 'herb' and 'ore' are gathering materials, sold only by merchants that stock those tags, and merchants buy them back at half price (crafted items, i.e. recipe outputs, at most at their material cost times recipes.json alchemy.crafted_sell_markup). equip (optional) makes an item equipment (Equipment system): {slot: weapon|armor, grade: int >= 1, stats: {attack|defense|max_hp|speed: flat bonus}, lifespan_drain (optional int years burned after every fight fought while it is equipped; evil artifacts)}; using it equips it. Equipment is tagged equipment (sold only by merchants that stock that tag). Forging manuals (learn_recipe for blacksmith recipes) are tagged smithing and sold by smithies. Talismans (tag talisman, every one needs a talisman_master recipe) are single-use items inscribed by Talisman Masters; most grant a temporary combat buff via the buff effect {id, name, days, mults: {attack|defense|max_hp|speed: fraction}}. combat (optional, CombatTalismans) makes a talisman one the player can ready for fights instead of using it: {kind: strike (opening damage) | shield (absorbs damage) | escape (turns a defeat into a flight), grade: 1 = mortal power, 2 = Qi Refining, ... (each grade multiplies power like a major realm), power: damage or shield at grade 1 (not needed for escape), tribulation (optional, shields only, 0..1, TRIB-001d): the fraction of the shield that holds against tribulation lightning instead of realms.json tribulation_shield_scale, for wards made for tribulations}; one of each readied talisman is burned per fight. Tag inscription marks talisman supplies and talisman manuals (sold by talisman stalls). Tag blood_art marks blood-path pills and manuals: only merchants that stock blood_art (the Blood Lotus Apothecary) sell them, not general stores. Tag scripture marks technique manuals sold by scripture pavilions (merchants with stock_tags scripture); cheap starter manuals stay untagged so village merchants keep selling them. array (optional, Abodes, G-006) makes an item an array disc an Array Master refines: {qi_density_bonus: fraction > 0}; set up at the player's abode (one at a time), it multiplies seclusion qi density by 1 + qi_density_bonus. Tag formation marks array discs and array manuals (sold by talisman stalls). An evil artifact may also carry equip `alignment_on_first_equip` (int): a one-time alignment shift the first time the player binds that artifact by equipping it (paid once per item, tracked in CharacterData.bound_artifacts).

items.name: Moon Cake
items.description: A round festival cake of sweet lotus-seed paste, pressed with a moon and a hare.

items.name: Paper Lantern
items.description: A hand-painted festival lantern that glows with a candle. Pretty, and a thoughtful thing to give.

items.name: Sweet Rice Ball
items.description: Glutinous rice dumplings in sesame paste, sold hot from a steaming pot at the lantern stalls.

items.name: Willow Branch
items.description: A green willow twig hung over the door at Qingming to keep wandering spirits from the threshold. Wave it and a faint ward settles over you.

items.name: Ancestor Incense
items.description: Three sticks of sandalwood incense for the graves of those who came before. Lighting them with a sincere heart settles the mind.

items.name: Osmanthus Wine
items.description: Pale, sweet wine steeped with autumn osmanthus blossoms. Poured for friends under the full moon.

items.name: Blank Talisman Paper
items.description: Yellow paper soaked in cinnabar ink, ready to hold a spell.

items.name: Golden Bell Talisman
items.description: Burn it to wrap yourself in a faint golden bell of qi that turns aside blows.

items.name: Swift Wind Talisman
items.description: A wind rune that lightens your body for days.

items.name: Vermilion Flame Talisman
items.description: Fire qi sealed in vermilion script. It sets your strikes ablaze for a few days.

items.name: Fire Strike Talisman
items.description: Ready it before a fight: it bursts into a fist of flame at the first exchange.

items.name: Earth Wall Talisman
items.description: Ready it before a fight: a shell of earth qi takes the blows meant for you.

items.name: Thousand-Li Escape Talisman
items.description: Ready it before a fight: if you are about to fall, it tears you away on a gust of wind.

items.name: Jade Vitality Talisman
items.description: A green rune that steeps your flesh in wood qi, hardening it against death.

items.name: Spirit Stone
items.description: Crystallized qi. The currency of cultivators.

items.name: Qi Gathering Pill
items.description: A common pill that floods the meridians with qi.

items.name: Superior Qi Gathering Pill
items.description: A flawless, pale-gold Qi Gathering Pill with almost no impurities.

items.name: Flawless Foundation Establishment Pill
items.description: A pill bearing a faint cloud pattern. Far better odds at your next major breakthrough.

items.name: Foundation Establishment Pill
items.description: Greatly improves the odds of your next major breakthrough.

items.name: Bone-Setting Salve
items.description: A pungent salve that knits broken bones overnight.

items.name: Meridian Mending Pill
items.description: Soothes qi deviation and calms wild meridians.

items.name: Jade Marrow Pill
items.description: A precious pill that heals every injury of body and meridian.

items.name: Spirit Gathering Pill
items.description: A richer pill that draws dense qi into the dantian. Favoured by late Qi Refining cultivators.

items.name: Visceral Mending Pill
items.description: A warm, bitter pill that knits torn organs after a hard fight.

items.name: Meridian Rebuilding Pill
items.description: Coaxes shattered meridians to regrow, strand by strand.

items.name: Meridian Restoring Pill
items.description: Cool as mountain mist, it lets ruptured meridians close around Foundation-level qi.

items.name: Dantian Sealing Pill
items.description: Seals a cracked dantian with a film of earth essence until the foundation heals whole.

items.name: Frost Jade Salve
items.description: A blue-white salve that draws the fire out of spirit burns.

items.name: Soul Calming Pill
items.description: Its fragrance reaches the soul itself and smooths over its scars.

items.name: Purifying Lotus Pill
items.description: Snow lotus essence that burns away demonic qi lodged in the body.

items.name: Core Mending Pill
items.description: A golden pill that fills the fissures of a cracked golden core. Core Formation elders hoard them.

items.name: Tiger-Bone Plaster
items.description: A stinking plaster of blood ginseng and fire lotus that welds a sundered body back together.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Meridian Restoring Pill
items.description: An Azure Cloud healer's formula for disciples who forced their foundation too fast. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Dantian Sealing Pill
items.description: Written for Foundation cultivators whose liquid qi leaks away. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Frost Jade Salve
items.description: A battlefield healer's salve for qi burns. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Soul Calming Pill
items.description: A jade slip that smells of temple incense. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Purifying Lotus Pill
items.description: A righteous alchemist's answer to the blood path. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Core Mending Pill
items.description: A Core Formation elder's private formula, sold only when the elder needed stones. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Tiger-Bone Plaster
items.description: A mercenary doctor's plaster for broken warriors. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Clear Heart Pill
items.description: Quiets the mind and washes away killing intent. Righteous alchemists swear by it.

items.name: Blood Demon Pill
items.description: A forbidden pill refined from blood and ginseng. It floods the meridians with power and stains the heart.

items.name: Core Forming Pill
items.description: A legendary pill that steadies the dantian while a golden core coalesces.

items.name: Soul Infant Pill
items.description: A pill that hushes the golden core while a nascent soul takes its first breath. A Core Formation cultivator's last great purchase.

items.name: Spirit Severing Pill
items.description: A pill that helps a Nascent Soul cut the last tie between soul and flesh, and walk as spirit alone.

items.name: Flawless Soul Infant Pill
items.description: A pill with a nine-ringed halo, free of every impurity. Far better odds at your next major breakthrough to Nascent Soul.

items.name: Flawless Spirit Severing Pill
items.description: A pill that glows like a cold moon, the cut between soul and flesh already half made. Far better odds at your next major breakthrough to Soul Formation.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Soul Infant Pill
items.description: A treasured formula that few alchemists ever see. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Spirit Severing Pill
items.description: A treasured formula that few alchemists ever see. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Soul Infant Fruit
items.description: A red fruit shaped like a sleeping child, ripening once in a thousand years. The scent alone makes a golden core tremble.

items.name: Soul Severing Lotus
items.description: A black-petalled lotus that grows where the line between life and death is thinnest. Only a Nascent Soul can pick it without dying.

items.name: Spirit Beast Pellet
items.description: Pressed herbs and bone meal. Spirit beasts wolf it down and grow a little stronger.

items.name: Beast Marrow Pill
items.description: A Beast Tamer's pill of blood ginseng and condensed qi that thickens a spirit beast's bones and blood.

items.name: Spirit Herb
items.description: A common herb steeped in qi. Chew it to refine a little energy.

items.name: Blood Ginseng
items.description: A centuries-old root, rich enough to steady a breakthrough.

items.name: Ancient Jade Slip
items.description: A long-dead cultivator's insights into the Dao, sealed in jade.

items.name: Morning Dew Grass
items.description: A common herb that holds a drop of qi in each blade.

items.name: Qi Condensing Grass
items.description: The main ingredient of Qi Gathering Pills.

items.name: Purple Cloud Mushroom
items.description: Grows on rotting spirit wood in deep mist. Calms the meridians.

items.name: Flame Lotus
items.description: A fire-attribute lotus that blooms only where earth-fire vents.

items.name: Ice Soul Flower
items.description: A frost-white flower from high peaks. Clears the mind before a breakthrough.

items.name: Thousand-Year Lingzhi
items.description: A legendary fungus. Alchemists would kill for one.

items.name: Boar Hide
items.description: Coarse bristled hide from a field boar, tough enough for a hunter's jerkin.

items.name: Mist Wolf Pelt
items.description: A grey pelt that still looks faintly damp with fog.

items.name: Fox Spirit Tail
items.description: A soft tail that glows pale when held in the dark, prized by alchemists for quickening qi.

items.name: Stone Ape Hide
items.description: Thick grey hide, hard as slate where the ape braced against the rock.

items.name: Azure Crane Feather
items.description: A long blue-white feather that sheds the wind. Talisman masters ink wind runes on it.

items.name: Cloud Eagle Talon
items.description: A hooked talon that rakes sparks off stone. Smiths and collectors both pay for it.

items.name: Blood-Eyed Wolf Fang
items.description: A crimson-stained fang that hums faintly with killing intent.

items.name: Jade Python Scale
items.description: A palm-sized green scale, cool as jade and nearly as hard. Core-stage beast armor is made from these.

items.name: Boar Hide Jerkin
items.description: A hunter's jerkin of stiff boar hide laced over an iron-ribbed frame.

items.name: Mist Wolf Pelt Cloak
items.description: A hooded cloak of grey wolf pelt; the fog-damp fur dulls blows and muffles footsteps.

items.name: Stone Ape Bracers
items.description: Slate-hard ape hide wrapped over cold iron plates. Blows glance off like rain off a cliff.

items.name: Cloud Eagle Talon Blade
items.description: A curved blade whose edge is a cloud eagle's talon set in cold iron. It strikes like a stoop from the clouds.

items.name: Wolf Fang Blood Pill
items.description: A crimson pill ground from a blood-eyed wolf's fang and flame lotus. It floods the limbs with a wolf's ferocity for a few days.

items.name: Jade Python Scale Armor
items.description: Overlapping green python scales sewn on azure-crystal plates; cool, supple and nearly proof against a Core cultivator's blade.

items.name: Crane Wing Talisman
items.description: A feather-inked rune that lifts your steps like a crane skimming a lake.

items.name: Fox Spirit Pill
items.description: A silvery pill with a fox's quick cunning; it stirs far more qi than a common pill.

items.name: Iron Essence
items.description: Iron ore with a trace of qi. Used by every apprentice smith.

items.name: Cold Iron
items.description: Ore that stays cold even in a forge. Takes a keen edge.

items.name: Azure Crystal
items.description: A crystal grown in qi-rich mountain veins. Prized by array masters.

items.name: Star Silver
items.description: Metal from a fallen star. Rare and sought after for artifacts.

items.name: Profound Iron
items.description: Dense black iron that will not soften in a mortal fire. Only a Foundation cultivator's forge-flame can work it.

items.name: Dragon-Blood Gold
items.description: Red-veined gold said to have formed where an ancient dragon bled into the mountain. Warm to the touch and fiercely sought by master smiths.

items.name: Manual: Basic Breathing Method
items.description: A dog-eared pamphlet. Teaches the Basic Breathing Method.

items.name: Manual: Blood Demon Rage
items.description: A scripture written in dried blood. Teaches the forbidden Blood Demon Rage, which burns years of life for power.

items.name: Manual: Blood Shadow Flight
items.description: A furtive pamphlet sold from under the counter. Teaches Blood Shadow Flight, which burns 5 years of life per use.

items.name: Manual: Ten-Thousand Bones Armor
items.description: Bound in cured skin and stitched with hair. Teaches Ten-Thousand Bones Armor, which burns 15 years of life per use.

items.name: Manual: Heaven-Devouring Burst
items.description: The pages hum with hunger. Teaches Heaven-Devouring Burst, which burns 40 years of life per use.

items.name: Manual: Iron Fist
items.description: Crude drawings of punches. Teaches Iron Fist.

items.name: Manual: Stone Skin Tempering
items.description: A body-tempering regimen carved on a slate. Teaches Stone Skin Tempering.

items.name: Manual: Verdant Spring Method
items.description: A wood-element main cultivation method (faster qi gathering, best with a wood root). Good up to Foundation Establishment.

items.name: Manual: Ember Heart Method
items.description: A fire-element main cultivation method (faster qi gathering, best with a fire root). Good up to Foundation Establishment.

items.name: Manual: Still Lake Method
items.description: A water-element main cultivation method (faster qi gathering, best with a water root). Good up to Foundation Establishment.

items.name: Manual: Iron Marrow Method
items.description: A metal-element main cultivation method (faster qi gathering, best with a metal root). Good up to Foundation Establishment.

items.name: Manual: Deep Loam Method
items.description: An earth-element main cultivation method (faster qi gathering, best with an earth root). Good up to Foundation Establishment.

items.name: Manual: Azure Cloud Heart Sutra
items.description: The Azure Cloud Sect's water-element main method, good through Core Formation. Only the sect hands it out, for contribution.

items.name: Manual: Azure Sky Primordial Canon
items.description: The Azure Cloud Sect's secret water-element canon, good to Void Refinement. Lent only to Elders, for a great deal of contribution.

items.name: Manual: Blood Sea Sovereign Scripture
items.description: The Blood Lotus Sect's forbidden fire-element scripture, good to Void Refinement. Only Blood Elders may read it.

items.name: Manual: Celestial Ledger Canon
items.description: The Myriad Treasure Pavilion's metal-element elder canon, good to Void Refinement. Sold only to Pavilion Elders, for contribution.

items.name: Manual: Netherwater Yin King Canon
items.description: A slip of black jade, cold as deep water, holding the Yin King's method. Any root can cultivate it, to Void Refinement.

items.name: Manual: Eternal Sky Canon of the Heavenly Dao
items.description: A righteous patriarch's last canon, written in clear jade. Teaches the Eternal Sky Canon, good through Mahayana. Requires Soul Formation.

items.name: Manual: Primordial Chaos Returning Art
items.description: A wandering alchemist's furnace-scorched notes. Teaches the Primordial Chaos Returning Art, good through Tribulation Transcendence. Requires Soul Formation.

items.name: Manual: Hundred Thousand Ghosts Sovereign Canon
items.description: A canon bound in the skin of the restless dead. Teaches the Ghost Sovereign Canon, good through Mahayana. Requires Soul Formation. Learning it stains the heart.

items.name: Manual: Golden Abacus Method
items.description: The Myriad Treasure Pavilion's metal-element main method, good through Core Formation. Only the Pavilion hands it out, for contribution.

items.name: Manual: Blood Lotus Rebirth Scripture
items.description: The Blood Lotus Sect's fire-element main method, good through Core Formation. Learning it stains the heart.

items.name: Manual: Mountain-and-Sea Breathing Art
items.description: A hermit's earth-element main method, good through Core Formation.

items.name: Manual: Nine Heavens Thunder Scripture
items.description: A lost sect's main method for any root, good through Nascent Soul. Requires Foundation Establishment.

items.name: Manual: Myriad Corpse Devouring Canon
items.description: A demonic main method for any root, good through Nascent Soul. Requires Foundation Establishment. Learning it stains the heart.

items.name: Manual: Flowing Water Sutra
items.description: A water-element cultivation method. Requires Qi Refining.

items.name: Manual: Blazing Sun Art
items.description: A fire-element cultivation method. Requires Qi Refining.

items.name: Manual: Metal Edge Sword Art
items.description: A metal-element sword art. Requires Qi Refining.

items.name: Manual: Drifting Wind Step
items.description: A wood-element movement art. Requires Qi Refining.

items.name: Manual: Cloud-Parting Palm
items.description: A neatly copied sect primer, the kind outer disciples sell when short of stones. Teaches a water-element palm art. Requires Qi Refining.

items.name: Manual: Burning Cinder Fist
items.description: Scorch marks on every page. Teaches a fire-element fist art. Requires Qi Refining.

items.name: Manual: Verdant Vine Lash
items.description: Written on pressed leaves bound with vine. Teaches a wood-element whip art. Requires Qi Refining.

items.name: Manual: Immovable Mountain Stance
items.description: Stance diagrams carved into a slab of mountain stone. Teaches an earth-element body art. Requires Qi Refining.

items.name: Manual: Golden Bell Shield
items.description: A sutra gifted by grateful monks. Teaches a metal-element body art. Requires Qi Refining.

items.name: Manual: Scarlet Blood Palm
items.description: The pages are stiff with old blood. Teaches a demonic palm art. Requires Qi Refining.

items.name: Manual: Nine Frost Sword Intent
items.description: A jade slip so cold it frosts your fingers. Teaches a water-element sword art. Requires Foundation Establishment.

items.name: Manual: Five Thunders Palm
items.description: A Daoist treatise sealed with a thunder talisman. Teaches a fire-element palm art. Requires Foundation Establishment.

items.name: Manual: Thousand Fallen Leaves Step
items.description: Footwork charts that seem to shift when you look away. Teaches a wood-element movement art. Requires Foundation Establishment.

items.name: Manual: Earth Dragon Body
items.description: Rubbings taken from a dragon-vein stele. Teaches an earth-element body art. Requires Foundation Establishment.

items.name: Manual: Corpse Qi Claw
items.description: Wrapped in burial silk and smelling of the grave. Teaches a demonic claw art. Requires Foundation Establishment.

items.name: Manual: Azure Heaven Sword Canon
items.description: A sword-shaped jade slip humming with ancient intent. Teaches a metal-element sword canon. Requires Core Formation.

items.name: Manual: Soul-Rending Demon Finger
items.description: A black bone slip that whispers when held. Teaches a demonic finger art. Requires Core Formation.

items.name: Manual: Rippling Moon Sword Art
items.description: A jade slip copied by a pavilion scribe, the moon's reflection drawn on every page. Teaches a water-element sword art. Requires Qi Refining.

items.name: Manual: Mountain-Splitting Fist
items.description: A quarryman's sect primer, its margins full of a master's corrections. Teaches an earth-element fist art. Requires Qi Refining.

items.name: Manual: Gold-Piercing Finger
items.description: A thin bronze booklet whose pages ring like coins. Teaches a metal-element finger art. Requires Qi Refining.

items.name: Blood Essence Burning Pill
items.description: A forbidden pill that ignites your own blood essence: a flood of qi, paid for with years of your life.

items.name: Longevity Pill
items.description: A legendary pill that knits fresh years onto a cultivator's life.

items.name: Celestial Fox Essence Blood
items.description: A drop of silver blood shed by a fox spirit on its way to heaven. Drinking it plants the Nine-Tailed Fox Bloodline in one who has none.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Meridian Mending Pill
items.description: An alchemist's notes on calming wild meridians. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Foundation Establishment Pill
items.description: A guarded formula, copied in a careful hand. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Jade Marrow Pill
items.description: A brittle scroll from a lost alchemy lineage. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Spirit Gathering Pill
items.description: Notes on doubling the potency of a common pill. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Visceral Mending Pill
items.description: A field medic's formula for internal wounds. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Meridian Rebuilding Pill
items.description: A sect elder's refinement of the mending formula. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Clear Heart Pill
items.description: A temple recipe, copied by a monk's steady hand. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Blood Demon Pill
items.description: A blood-spotted scroll that circulates only in dark markets. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Core Forming Pill
items.description: A treasured formula that few alchemists ever see. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Iron Sword
items.description: A plain sword of qi-tempered iron. Better than bare fists.

items.name: Iron Scale Armor
items.description: Overlapping iron scales sewn onto leather.

items.name: Cold Iron Saber
items.description: A frost-edged saber that bites through hide and bone.

items.name: Flawless Cold Iron Saber
items.description: A masterwork saber without a single impurity. Frost mist trails its edge.

items.name: Blood-Drinker Saber
items.description: A crimson demonic saber that hungers for life. Its power is immense, but every battle it drinks a year of its wielder's lifespan.

items.name: Azure Guard Robe
items.description: A robe woven with star silver thread and azure crystal plates. Turns aside blades and qi alike.

items.name: Gold-Thread Talisman Paper
items.description: Spirit-silk paper threaded with gold and soaked in beast-blood cinnabar. It can hold a Foundation cultivator's script without burning up.

items.name: Vajra Diamond Talisman
items.description: A Buddhist seal in golden script. Burned, it hardens your body like a temple guardian's for a week.

items.name: Thunder God Talisman
items.description: Purple lightning crackles inside the paper. For three days your every strike carries the wrath of heaven.

items.name: Ghost Shadow Talisman
items.description: A grey rune that thins your shadow until you move like a wandering ghost.

items.name: Blood Sacrifice Talisman
items.description: Written in a living victim's heart-blood. Burning it fills you with savage strength, and stains your Dao heart a little more.

items.name: Five Thunder Talisman
items.description: Ready it before a fight: five bolts of lightning fall on your foe at the first exchange.

items.name: Black Tortoise Shell Talisman
items.description: Ready it before a fight: the phantom shell of the Black Tortoise closes around you.

items.name: Heaven-Splitting Sword Talisman
items.description: Ready it before a fight: a sword intent sealed by a Core Formation sword cultivator, enough to cleave a hill in two.

items.name: Minor Spirit Gathering Array
items.description: Nine jade-tipped flags and a palm-sized array disc. Planted around a cave abode, they draw in stray qi from the surroundings.

items.name: Five-Element Qi Gathering Array
items.description: Five element-aligned array plates that turn qi in a slow vortex around your abode, thickening it like morning mist.

items.name: Array Manual: Five-Element Qi Gathering Array
items.description: A worn formation diagram annotated in three different hands. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Formation Flags
items.description: A bundle of qi-conductive silk flags on spirit-bamboo poles, the bones of every larger array.

items.name: Formation Jade
items.description: Jade that has soaked in a dragon vein for centuries. Array masters carve their master runes into it.

items.name: Nine Palaces Gathering Array
items.description: Nine array plates laid out in the Luo Shu square. Qi circles through the palaces and pools at the center like water in a basin.

items.name: Heaven-and-Earth Spirit Array
items.description: A Core Formation array that ties the abode to the sky above and the vein below, pulling qi from both.

items.name: Myriad Star Gathering Array
items.description: Three hundred and sixty-five star-silver nodes map the night sky onto your abode. On clear nights the qi falls like starlight.

items.name: Array Manual: Nine Palaces Gathering Array
items.description: A Foundation array master's diagram, every palace annotated. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Array Manual: Heaven-and-Earth Spirit Array
items.description: A sect treasury copy, sealed with the sect's mark. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Array Manual: Myriad Star Gathering Array
items.description: A star chart folded a hundred times, each fold a rune. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Talisman Manual: Vajra Diamond Talisman
items.description: A temple monk's copybook of golden seal script. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Talisman Manual: Thunder God Talisman
items.description: Strokes copied from a thunder-struck stele. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Talisman Manual: Ghost Shadow Talisman
items.description: A thin booklet that seems to vanish when you look away. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Talisman Manual: Five Thunder Talisman
items.description: The Five Thunder rites of a Daoist lineage. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Talisman Manual: Black Tortoise Shell Talisman
items.description: Diagrams of the northern guardian's shell, drawn in black ink. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Talisman Manual: Heaven-Splitting Sword Talisman
items.description: A sword cultivator's last testament, how to fold sword intent into paper. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Talisman Manual: Blood Sacrifice Talisman
items.description: A demonic manual bound in human skin. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Corpse-Silk Burial Armor
items.description: A burial shroud woven from the silk of corpse-eating spiders, still cold from the coffin. Blades slide off it, but each battle it wraps tighter and draws a year of life from its wearer.

items.name: Myriad Souls Banner
items.description: A black banner in which ten thousand slaughtered souls howl. Waved in battle it tears through flesh and qi alike, and every fight it feeds them two years of its bearer's life.

items.name: Profound Iron Spear
items.description: A long spear of black profound iron. Its weight alone can shatter a Qi Refining cultivator's guard.

items.name: Flawless Profound Iron Spear
items.description: A masterwork spear whose tip never dulls. A faint dragon-roar follows each thrust.

items.name: Profound Iron Lamellar
items.description: Hundreds of profound iron plates laced with spirit silk. Heavy, but it turns aside sword qi.

items.name: Star River Sword
items.description: A blade of star silver folded with dragon-blood gold. Swung at night, it leaves a trail like the Milky Way.

items.name: Vermilion Dragon Scale Armor
items.description: Scales of dragon-blood gold set over star silver mail. It glows red when struck, as if the dragon still lives.

items.name: Nine Sky Thunder Sword
items.description: A sword quenched in the lightning of a Nascent Soul's tribulation. Its edge crackles whenever the wielder's resolve does.

items.name: Soul-Warding Dragon Mail
items.description: Dragon-blood gold plates etched with soul-sealing runes. It shelters the Nascent Soul as a shell shelters a pearl.

items.name: Void-Severing Saber
items.description: A blade so thin it seems to cut the space beside it. Those who watch it fall say the air itself parts a breath too late.

items.name: Heaven's Mandate Robe
items.description: A robe of star silver and dragon-blood gold threads, woven under a Soul Formation cultivator's decree. Lesser laws slide off it.

items.name: Forging Manual: Profound Iron Spear
items.description: A smith's notes on tempering profound iron without cracking it. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Forging Manual: Profound Iron Lamellar

items.name: Forging Manual: Star River Sword
items.description: A master smith's secret for folding star silver with dragon-blood gold. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Forging Manual: Vermilion Dragon Scale Armor
items.description: A jade slip pressed with the forging memories of an ancient dragon-hunting smith. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Forging Manual: Nine Sky Thunder Sword
items.description: A guardian's last memory of how thunder is folded into star silver. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Forging Manual: Soul-Warding Dragon Mail
items.description: A jade slip of soul-sealing rune smithing, pried from a basilisk's hoard. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Forging Manual: Void-Severing Saber
items.description: A smith's notes on tempering steel against the void. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Forging Manual: Heaven's Mandate Robe
items.description: Thread-by-thread instructions for a robe that wears a decree. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Cloud-Mist Orchid
items.description: A hundred-year orchid that only opens inside the cloud sea. Its petals are half qi, half mist.

items.name: Scarlet Flame Fruit
items.description: A fist-sized fruit ripened over an earth-fire vent for a century. Too hot to eat raw.

items.name: Hundred-Year Snow Lotus
items.description: A snow lotus that has seen a hundred winters. Chewing a petal chills the meridians clean.

items.name: Earth Marrow Fungus
items.description: A pale fungus fed by the marrow of the earth, deep in old mountain roots. Heavy as stone.

items.name: Nine-Leaf Soul Grass
items.description: A grass that grows one leaf per hundred years. At nine leaves it nourishes the soul itself.

items.name: Golden Core Lotus Seed
items.description: The seed of a thousand-year lotus, round and golden like a formed core. Core Formation alchemists fight over them.

items.name: Earth-Vein Jade
items.description: Green jade threaded with veins of condensed earth qi. Steadies arrays and forges alike.

items.name: Fire Marrow Crystal
items.description: A red crystal that formed where a fallen star burned into the ground. It never cools.

items.name: Autumn Bog Lily
items.description: A pale lily that opens on the black water only when the first frosts come, and rots within the week. Alchemists prize its cold, clean qi.

items.name: Bog Lily Qi Pill
items.description: A frost-white pill brewed from the autumn lily. It sinks into the dantian slowly and leaves no impurities.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Bog Lily Qi Pill
items.description: A marsh alchemist's formula, stained with swamp water. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Cloud-Mist Qi Pill
items.description: A misty-white pill that pours a season of cultivation into a Foundation cultivator's dantian.

items.name: Soul Nourishing Pill
items.description: Warms and steadies the soul so it does not crack under the pressure of a breakthrough.

items.name: Earth Marrow Essence Pill
items.description: A heavy golden pill that feeds a formed core like a river feeds a lake.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Cloud-Mist Qi Pill
items.description: An Azure Cloud outer-court formula, copied many times. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Soul Nourishing Pill
items.description: A jade slip humming with a dead alchemist's calm. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Earth Marrow Essence Pill
items.description: A heavy stone tablet carved by a Core Formation alchemist. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Slaughter Stele Rubbing
items.description: Ink rubbings from a stele that a demonic patriarch carved after razing a city. Studying them grants a glimpse of the Dao of Slaughter, and stains the soul.

items.name: Thunder-Scarred Jade
items.description: Jade struck by heavenly lightning, its veins still crackling. Holding it, you glimpse the Thunder Dao.

items.name: Nine Heavens Lightning-Warding Talisman
items.description: Ready it before a fight or a tribulation: a dome of earth-jade script that drinks lightning. Its script holds against heaven better than an ordinary shield, though only one ward can stand against the lightning at a time.

items.name: Heaven-Screening Umbrella Talisman
items.description: Ready it before a fight or a tribulation: a phantom umbrella of star-silver script opens over your head and turns aside heaven's wrath itself.

items.name: Soul-Sheltering Thunder Ward
items.description: A ward folded for one purpose: to stand between a Nascent Soul and the lightning that would scatter it. Flimsy against an ordinary blow.

items.name: Void-Anchoring Thunder Ward
items.description: Nailed to the void with nine silver spikes of script, it holds a Soul Formation cultivator in place while heaven tries to erase them. Little use in a brawl.

items.name: Body-Sealing Heaven Ward
items.description: Seals body and soul inside a shell of refined void before the tribulation of Body Integration. Made for heaven's lightning, not for swords.

items.name: Great Vehicle Lightning Canopy
items.description: A canopy of golden script under which a Body Integration master meets the Mahayana tribulation. It bends lightning; it barely notices fists.

items.name: Heaven-Defying Tribulation Ward
items.description: Said to be drawn in a Mahayana elder's own blood. It cannot stop the final tribulation, but it can blunt its first blows.

items.name: Talisman Manual: Nine Heavens Lightning-Warding Talisman
items.description: Notes from a talisman master who survived three tribulations, every stroke annotated in a shaking hand. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Talisman Manual: Soul-Sheltering Thunder Ward
items.description: The folding of a ward against heaven's lightning, set down by a master who lived to the next realm. Needs a 5th Grade Talisman Master. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Talisman Manual: Void-Anchoring Thunder Ward
items.description: The folding of a ward against heaven's lightning, set down by a master who lived to the next realm. Needs a 6th Grade Talisman Master. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Talisman Manual: Body-Sealing Heaven Ward
items.description: The folding of a ward against heaven's lightning, set down by a master who lived to the next realm. Needs a 7th Grade Talisman Master. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Talisman Manual: Great Vehicle Lightning Canopy
items.description: The folding of a ward against heaven's lightning, set down by a master who lived to the next realm. Needs a 8th Grade Talisman Master. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Talisman Manual: Heaven-Defying Tribulation Ward
items.description: The folding of a ward against heaven's lightning, set down by a master who lived to the next realm. Needs a 9th Grade Talisman Master. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Talisman Manual: Heaven-Screening Umbrella Talisman
items.description: A scorched jade slip, still warm, recovered from where a cultivator fell to the heavens. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Thunder-Tempering Body Pill
items.description: Swallowed before a tribulation, it hardens skin and marrow so the first bolts feel like rain. Lasts five days.

items.name: Buddha's Light Heart-Guarding Pill
items.description: A temple pill that steadies the Dao heart and wraps the body in gentle light. Righteous cultivators take it on the eve of a tribulation.

items.name: Blood Shroud Pill
items.description: Refined from blood ginseng steeped in a victim's heart-blood. For three days your body swells with stolen vitality, and your soul darkens a little.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Thunder-Tempering Body Pill
items.description: A lightning-scarred bamboo scroll from a body-cultivation lineage. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Buddha's Light Heart-Guarding Pill
items.description: Copied from a monastery's sutra library by a monk who never asked for payment. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Blood Shroud Pill
items.description: Written in a cramped hand on tanned skin. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Yin King Gate Token
items.description: A black jade token cold as a drowned hand, carved with the Yin King's seal. When the marsh draws back, it hums toward the sunken gates of his palace.

items.name: Sword Tomb Map Fragment
items.description: A scrap of sword-scarred silk marked with the hidden way into the Sunken Sword Tomb on Azure Peak, copied by a disciple who never came back out.
